description: 新北市公共自行車租賃系統(YouBike2.0) [bus and public transit and cycling and walking networks] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 新北市政府交通局. 為提升市民使用新北市公共自行車租賃系統(YouBike2. 0)服務品質，透過資料透明化，提供各資訊平台介接取得系統服務即時資訊，滿足市民第一哩及最後ㄧ哩公共運輸需求。. Coverage: 新北市政府交通局. The portal files it under the publisher 新北市政府交通局. Its tags are 交通及通訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
